wu: Color Ball Toss: Teacher throws a ball to a student and says 'What color is it?' Student catches it and says 'It is red.' Student throws to another student and asks 'What color is it?' and so on.
wuAlt: Color Jump: Students jump on colored mats. Teacher says 'Jump on red!' and students jump. Then students say 'Jump on blue!' and teacher jumps.
Color Flashcard Slap: Teacher shows flashcards quickly. Students slap the card and say the color word.
pres: Teacher holds up red, blue, yellow, green, black flashcards and says each word clearly. Students repeat. Teacher models 'What color is it?' and answers 'It is red.' Teacher holds up a red apple and asks 'What color is it?' Students answer 'It is red.'
presAlt: Color Story: Teacher reads a story about a bird with red feathers, blue wings, etc. Students point to the colors in the book.
Color Magic: Teacher has a bag of colored objects. Students reach in without looking, feel the object, and guess the color.
prac: Spelling Relay: Teams line up. Teacher says 'Spell red!' First student runs to the board, writes R-E-D, runs back. Team does this for all 5 colors. Teacher checks spelling.
pracAlt: Color Bingo: Teacher calls out colors. Students cover the matching picture on their bingo card. First to get a line wins.
Color Chain: Students sit in a circle. Student 1 says 'I see something red.' Student 2 says 'I see something red and blue.' and so on, adding one color each time.
ls: Listen and Color: Teacher says 'Color the apple red.' 'Color the sky blue.' Students color a picture of an apple and sky. Teacher checks if they colored correctly.
re: Color Hopscotch: Draw a hopscotch grid with colored squares. Students jump and say the color of the square they land on. 'Blue! Green! Yellow!'
prod: What's in the Box? Teacher puts a colored object in a box. Students ask 'What color is it?' by taking turns. Student guesses 'It is red!' Teacher opens the box to see if correct.
rw: Color-by-Word: Students have a sheet with shapes. Each shape has a color word. They read 'red' and color the shape red. 'blue' and color blue, etc. Then they trace the color words.
st: Teacher sings 'I Can Sing a Rainbow' with actions. Students join in. Goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.
g: Teams take turns. A student thinks of a colored object. Team asks 'What color is it?' until they guess correctly.
Students take turns turning over two cards. If they match, they say the color word and keep the cards.
Teacher says 'I spy with my little eye something red.' Students guess 'Is it a pen?'
Teams race to sort colored objects into red, blue, yellow, green, black piles.
Student acts out an object. Other students ask 'What color is it?' and guess.
diff: Fast finishers / stronger learners: Write a sentence about their favorite color: 'My favorite color is red.'
Support / weaker learners: Use a word bank with the 5 color words to copy from.
hw: Play the matching game in the colors library folder with a family member.
Draw 5 objects, each a different color, and write the color word under each one.
Ask your family 'What is your favorite color?' and write down their answers.
tip: Use realia like Moroccan fruits (red apples, yellow bananas) to connect colors to local culture and make learning more relevant.
